    import funcy.calc as calc
    cache = calc.cache

    call_count_custom = [0]

    @cache(60)  # default key_func
    def f_default(x):

        return x * 2

    @cache(60, key_func=lambda x: x % 2)  # custom key_func
    def f_custom(x):

        return x * 2

    r3 = f_custom(1)
    r4 = f_custom(3)
    assert r3 == 2
    assert r4 == 2  # cached from first call
    assert call_count_custom[0] == 1  # only one computation

    """key_func must produce the same key for the same logical input every time."""

        return x * 2

    # Each distinct value should be computed once
